page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top with page number left and chapter title right; small printed marginal scribbles at the left edge (illegible, not transcribed); no notes beside the text; catchword "Cœ-" at the lower right; faint reference lines at the bottom left.

main_text.p: tur. Verùm in attributo ipsa res significata ponitur pro signo illius rei.
main_text.head: XLV. Finis cuius est, I. ut inter cœnandum Christi solenniter recordemur; & fides in Ipsum, pro nobis mortuum, & ad justitiam ac salutem nobis communicatum, suscitetur & confirmetur, Luc. 22, 19. 1 Cor. xi, 24, 25.
main_text.p: 2. Ut beneficia N. Test. continuentur, & promoveantur: talis enim promissio appósita est usui Panis; Luc. 22, 19. 1 Cor. xi, 24. x, 16. & Vini; Matth. 26, 28. 1 Cor. x, 16. xii, 13.
3. Ut excitemur ad Servatorem nostrum debitâ gratitudine colendum & celebrandum: 1 Cor. xi. 26.

4. Ut extimulemur ad mutuæ dilectionis & communionis studium: 1 Cor. 10, 17. Serió autem fugimus diffidia, & contemtum fratrum: xi, 18, 20, 22, Finis vero cui est Cœtus baptizatorum adultorum, fidem ac resipiscentiam ore & opere profitentium.
1. Cœtus requiritur; exemplo primæ S. Cœnæ: 1 Cor. xi, 20. x, 16, 17.
2. Et quidem baptizatorum; prius enim est nasci, quàm pasci; adeòque & Sacramentum regenerationis, quàm spiritualis nutritionis: Matth. 28, 19. Tit. 3, 5. Hebr. 6, 2, cum Exod. 12, 48.
3. Eorumque adultorum: isti enim soli sunt habiles ad officia in hoc Sacramento necessaria: 1 Cor. xi, 24-29.

4. Denique talium, qui fidem ac resipiscentiam ore & opere profiteantur. Hoc Pastores videre debent sedulò: 1 Cor. 10, 21, xi, 20, 27, 28. Sed & sincera debet esse illa professio: Joh. 6, 27, 29. Rom. 10, 10, Gal. 5, 6. Alias incurritur crimen Corporis ac Sanguinis Christi violati: 1 Cor. xi, 29. Fideles castigationibus fiunt obnoxii; 30, 31, 32. Hypocritæ autem æternæ damnationi; Matth. 24, 51. Marc. 16, 16. Rom. 8, 13.

page.notes: Marginal scribbles at the left edge and faint printed numbers at the bottom left (e.g. "I 35", "I 33 I", "x 28 x") are damaged or stray and were not transcribed. Greek-free page; the heading "XLV" is set in the running text rather than as a separate line.
